jobs.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer III (Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote  
**Work Type:** Full Time Regular  
**Job No:** 505280  
**Categories:** Information Technology  
**Application Closes:** Closes Oct 30, 2026

2026-10-02

At Mutual of Omaha, we're modernizing how we connect with customers, partners, producers and third-party vendor solutions through an API-first integration strategy. We're seeking a seasoned software engineer who thrives in building cloud-native applications, enterprise integrations, and scalable APIs while remaining hands-on and serving as a mentor to other developers.

Life Insurance Solutions is committed to helping customers protect what’s important to them. The proceeds from our life policies are often used to pay off mortgages, send kids to college and enable a secure retirement. In this role, you'll help shape the future of our Life Insurance Underwriting platform by designing and delivering solutions using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, MuleSoft, and modern API technologies. You'll play a critical role in driving integration modernization efforts, influencing technical decisions, and helping establish engineering best practices across the team.

**WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
  + - Engineer II: $115,000 - $135,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    - Engineer III: $135,000 - $155,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
* 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
* Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
* Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Play a key role in modernizing Mutual of Omaha's Life Insurance platform through the development and support of enterprise APIs and integration solutions.
* Design, develop, deploy, and support Java and Spring Boot applications within AWS cloud environments.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and reusable integration services that enable secure connectivity with third-party vendor solutions,customers, and business partners.
* Design and implement MuleSoft integrations using Anypoint Platform, DataWeave, and API-led connectivity principles.
* Partner with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
* Serve as a senior technical contributor by mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and promoting software engineering best practices.
* Influence application design, API standards, integration architecture, and technical direction across the team.
* Collaborate with architects and engineering leaders to evaluate emerging technologies and advance modernization initiatives.
* Promote operational excellence through automation, CI/CD practices, continuous improvement, and quality-focused development.
* Lead by example in delivering secure, resilient, and high-performing software solutions

  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING:**

* 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise software solutions.
* Experience leading medium to large projects from a technical perspective - leading other engineers within the project to provide technical guidance and direction
* Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Experience developing and supporting applications in AWS cloud environments.
* Experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
* Strong understanding of API design, API lifecycle management, security standards, and integration patterns.
* Experience utilizing AI tools and implementing AI-enabled solutions to enhance software development, improve team productivity, accelerate delivery, and support day-to-day technical decision-making.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and business domains.
* Experience mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and contributing to a collaborative engineering culture.
* Ability to influence technical direction and participate in architectural and design discussions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
* Ability to work remotely with reliable high-speed internet access while residing in the United States or Puerto Rico.

**PREFERRED:**

* Experience with relational and non-relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or DynamoDB.
* Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript development.
* Experience designing and supporting event-driven architectures and messaging solutions.
* Experience working within a SAFe Agile environment.
* Previous experience serving as a technical lead, senior developer, or mentor within an engineering organization.
* Experience supporting large-scale modernization, integration, or digital transformation initiatives.

  

**This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.**

**We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements**

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at careers@mutualofomaha.com. Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

**Stay Safe from Job Scams**  
Mutual of Omaha only accepts applications from mutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers

jobs.description:
**Role**: Senior/Staff Backend Engineer  
  
HRforGrowth® is engaged as the talent acquisition partner to conduct this search on behalf of a client organization that is hiring for this role. HRforGrowth is not the employer for this position. HRforGrowth identifies, evaluates, and presents top-tier candidates through its global talent acquisition practice; all employment decisions — including final selection, offer terms, compensation, and conditions of employment — are made solely by the hiring organization.

Our Client is seeking a highly experienced Senior/Staff Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help build and scale large-scale infrastructure for conversational AI. This position is ideal for an engineer who has built or been a core contributor to a database, queue, or large-scale data system and has a strong understanding of distributed systems and infrastructure.  
  
The successful candidate will play a critical role in scaling simulation infrastructure from 30K to 200K+ concurrent voice agent calls while helping build a purpose-built database for conversational AI. The ideal candidate will be AI-native, strongly biased toward action, comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment, and experienced in scaling infrastructure under real production workloads.

**Location**: Remote  
**Job Type**: Full-Time  
**Compensation**:$160,000 – $240,000 per year  
**Equity**: 0.2% – 1.0%  
**Visa Sponsorship**: Not available; U.S. Citizens and Green Card Holders only

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement storage structures, query paths, and retrieval systems that operate efficiently at scale.
* Scale simulation infrastructure from 30K to 200K+ concurrent calls while architecting for graceful degradation and 99.99% uptime.
* Own core backend services using TypeScript/Node.js and Python.
* Build backend systems that orchestrate LiveKit, Temporal, STT/TTS, and LLM tooling for real-time voice agents.
* Harden production monitoring pipelines so telephony events, recordings, and outcomes propagate reliably across services at massive scale.
* Deepen observability using OpenTelemetry, SigNoz, and trace-first practices.
* Improve system visibility so production issues and system behavior can be understood quickly and efficiently.
* Design and build infrastructure capable of handling high-volume, real-time workloads.
* Identify system bottlenecks, investigate performance issues, and implement scalable solutions.
* Ship the smallest working element quickly, learn from production usage, and iterate continuously.
* Work in an engineering environment that deploys to production multiple times per day.
* Contribute to infrastructure and backend architecture decisions as the company scales.
* Take ownership of complex technical problems and drive solutions from implementation through production.

  
**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 to 15 years of experience in backend/infrastructure engineering, with strong database and distributed systems experience.
* Proven experience building or being a core contributor to the storage or query layer of a database, queue, or large-scale data system, ideally within the last three years.
* Deep expertise in database technologies such as Postgres, Redis, Kafka, or ClickHouse.
* Experience scaling distributed systems under real production workloads, including GB-to-TB per day, high cardinality, tight SLAs, and clearly defined performance bottlenecks.
* Proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with cloud-native infrastructure, including AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
* Experience with workflow engines such as Temporal or Cadence.
* Experience building database and distributed infrastructure systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of systems design and infrastructure engineering.
* Experience working at a VC-backed startup, preferably Series A or later.
* Strong ability to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
* Demonstrated ability to prototype quickly, iterate, and ship production solutions within days rather than months.
* AI-native engineering approach, with daily experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex.
* Ability to form informed opinions about LLM capabilities and tradeoffs and determine when different AI tools or approaches should be used.
* Strong passion for and mastery of systems design and infrastructure.
* Must be able to work during U.S. working hours.
* U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience at an observability, data infrastructure, or database company, such as Datadog, Temporal, ClickHouse, or Stripe.
* Experience as a founding engineer or early employee at a startup.
* Experience building real-time voice, audio, or telephony pipelines.
* Background in Scala, Rust, or Haskell, demonstrating systems-level engineering experience.
* Open-source contributions or personal projects involving systems or databases.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  
The ideal candidate is a senior infrastructure or backend engineer who has worked deeply on databases, queues, distributed systems, or other large-scale data infrastructure. This person should be comfortable working close to the storage and query layers and solving difficult scalability, reliability, and performance problems under real production load.  
  
The candidate should have a strong bias toward action, be comfortable building and shipping quickly, and have experience working in a high-growth startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy.  
  
The role is particularly suited to an engineer who is AI-native, actively uses AI-assisted coding tools, and has thoughtful perspectives on how and when to use LLM capabilities in software development.  
  
Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where engineers are expected to build rather than remain limited to narrow responsibilities or extended planning cycles

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Avenrix Services is hiring a Backend Engineer to work on an active enterprise client project involving backend services, data processing, search, and AI-assisted workflows.

The role is primarily focused on **Node.js/TypeScript development, PostgreSQL, APIs, data synchronization, production troubleshooting, and reliability**.

You’ll work with an existing production system and collaborate with engineers across backend, data, search, and AI-related areas.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain backend services using **Node.js and TypeScript**
* Build and maintain REST APIs and backend integrations
* Work with **PostgreSQL and SQL**
* Debug database queries and backend performance issues
* Support ETL, data pipelines, and synchronization between systems
* Investigate data inconsistencies, failed jobs, and production issues
* Help improve application reliability and data consistency
* Work with AWS-based services and environments
* Write automated tests and participate in code reviews
* Use logs, metrics, and tracing to troubleshoot issues
* Collaborate with engineers working on search, data, and AI-related functionality
* Participate in technical meetings and provide clear updates on your work, blockers, and technical decisions

**Required Skills**

* **2+ years of professional software development experience** or equivalent strong practical experience
* Good experience with **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* Backend development experience with **Node.js**
* Good knowledge of **SQL and relational databases**
* Experience with **PostgreSQL** or a similar database
* Experience developing or integrating REST APIs
* Familiarity with Git and standard development workflows
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand and work within an existing codebase
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks
* Good written and spoken English for technical communication
* Reliable, receptive to feedback, and willing to learn unfamiliar technologies

**Preferred Skills**

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

* AWS
* ETL or data pipelines
* Kafka or other event/messaging systems
* OpenTelemetry
* Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or similar observability tools
* OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
* Docker
* Python
* GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools
* Distributed systems
* RAG / LLM applications
* AI or data-science workflows

**AI-Assisted Development**

Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools is welcome.

Candidates should still be able to understand, test, debug, and clearly explain the code they submit.

**What We Value**

We’re looking for someone who:

* Takes responsibility for their work
* Learns quickly
* Is comfortable receiving technical feedback
* Communicates problems and blockers clearly
* Investigates issues instead of guessing
* Can explain why they chose a particular implementation
* Is willing to suggest improvements when they see a better approach

**About Avenrix Services**

Avenrix Services supports businesses through project-based engineering and technology delivery across software, data, cloud, and AI-related initiatives.

For this engagement, you’ll contribute to an active enterprise technology project while working with engineering and project leadership.

Pay: $16.00-$24.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
